scope: Theorem 1.1 (Complementary cosets control Fourier matrices) of the manuscript “From partial permutation information to Fourier bounds” (preprints/From-partial-permutation-information-to-Fourier-bounds-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88926b5e48099ed8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 1-2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Partition X into b nonempty sets M1, . . . , Mb. Put Hi = HMi . Suppose f is a nonnegative measure on G of mass at most one and, for every g ∈ G and i, f(gHi) ≤ B [G : Hi] . (1.1) 1 For every u > 0 and every irreducible ρ of degree D, ∥ b f(ρ)∥2 HS ≤ bBCuD−1+(u+2)/b . (1.2) There is also an independent orbit-span proof of the bound ∥ b f(ρ)∥2 op ≤ bBCuD−1+(u+2)/b .
